capabilities.description: Track SKUs, quantities on hand, and reorder thresholds; update stock counts manually or via import.
Capture incoming orders, update fulfillment status through a simple workflow, and maintain order history.
A single-screen dashboard showing current inventory levels, open orders, and recent activity for day-to-day monitoring.
Notify staff when items fall below reorder thresholds or when orders are stalled.
Maintain a simple knowledge base of pilot run notes, supplier contacts, and process quirks.

summary: A lightweight operations tracker for small retail teams running a pilot. It centralizes inventory counts, order status, and a simple dashboard so staff can see what's in stock, what's been ordered, and what needs attention without adopting a full ERP.
